saw_lines: Beauty buyers pick a palette by one swatch or one review, then reorder the same shade without thinking.
So the sale is won on the first screen, where the offer or the swatch has to earn the click.
Your site offers a €50 first order voucher and 500 points, so open three new Meta ads with it, tested against your 15 live ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers a €50 first order voucher and 500 points. A new buyer needs that offer in the ad to act today. Open three Meta ads with the voucher and test them against your 15 live ads.

Your site promotes up to 50% on palettes and free shipping over 45€. Shoppers scrolling Meta decide fast, so both offers have to show first. Run one ad on palettes and one on free shipping, with the offer on the creative.

Your site names over 50 people and over 1,000,000 orders, your strongest proof. Buyers meet it only after a click, so put 1,000,000 orders on the creative. Open one video with the 50 person team and test it against your ads.

Your Google set has 117 creatives, only 4 of them video, against 16 text and 20 image. Palettes sell on colour on skin, which a still frame cannot show. Shoot three clips and run them against your 15 live Meta ads.

ads_1: Palette videos on real skin, tested against your current Meta ads
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram and TikTok, your two linked channels
